env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
mkdir -p .nix-stubs
if [ -e tools/mig/mig.sh ]; then
  ln -sf "$PWD/tools/mig/mig.sh" .nix-stubs/mig
fi
ln -sf "/nix/store/gxzbfc870kyb80wzkf0jgcp7lw2k0311-puredarwin-migcom-native-0.1/bin/migcom" .nix-stubs/migcom
ln -sf "/nix/store/88na65s5i18lqy9afdwai51xzrk2z1v7-puredarwin-unifdef-native-0.1/bin/unifdef" .nix-stubs/unifdef
    cat > .nix-stubs/libtool <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = "-static" ] && [ "$2" = "-o" ]; then
  out="$3"
  shift 3
  exec arm64-apple-darwin20.4-ar rcs "$out" "$@"
fi
if [ "$1" = "-ca" ]; then
  shift
  out=""
  members=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      -filelist)
        members="$members $(cat "$2")"
        shift 2
        ;;
      -o)
        out="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
      *)
        members="$members $1"
        shift
        ;;
    esac
  done
  exec arm64-apple-darwin20.4-ar rcs "$out" $members
fi
echo "unsupported libtool invocation: $*" >&2
exit 1
EOF
    chmod +x .nix-stubs/libtool
export PATH="$PWD/.nix-stubs:$PWD/build-nix/tools/mig:$PWD/build-nix/tools/cctools/misc:$PWD/build-nix/tools/dtrace_ctf/tools:$PATH"

ninja -C build-nix  xnu
runHook postBuild
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure
# xnu's SETUP tools run on the build machine. On a Mac they require stdenv's SDK (initially $SDKROOT), not ours.
hostSdkRoot="${SDKROOT:-}"
export DEVELOPER_DIR="/nix/store/6zpwyx6p9swad42f0vx6rl4z0dp2kj1g-puredarwin-oss-sdk-26.5"
export DARWIN_SDK_ROOT="$DEVELOPER_DIR/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk"
# xnu's makefiles otherwise resolve these by shelling out to xcrun again,
# which fails in the nix sandbox and leaves its error text in $(PLATFORM).
export SDKROOT="$DARWIN_SDK_ROOT"
export SDKROOT_RESOLVED="$DARWIN_SDK_ROOT"
export HOST_SDKROOT_RESOLVED="$DARWIN_SDK_ROOT"
export PUREDARWIN_SDKROOT="$DARWIN_SDK_ROOT"
export NIX_CXXSTDLIB_COMPILE=""
export NIX_CXXSTDLIB_COMPILE_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu=""
export PLATFORM=MacOSX
# xnu defaults HOST_GM4 to the system gm4, which aborts on CoreFoundation's
# fork-without-exec guard when flex forks it. Use nixpkgs m4, as Linux does.
export HOST_GM4=/nix/store/7bpdkkmnwn11n66544n3mzmv5qfyxds0-gnum4-1.4.21/bin/m4
# keep the build directory out of kernel and kext binaries
prefixMap="-ffile-prefix-map=$NIX_BUILD_TOP=/puredarwin -fdebug-prefix-map=$NIX_BUILD_TOP=/puredarwin"
export CFLAGS="$prefixMap" CXXFLAGS="$prefixMap" OBJCFLAGS="$prefixMap" ASMFLAGS="$prefixMap"
# xnu's MakeInc.def tests RC_NONARCH_CFLAGS but reads the misspelt RC_NONARCH_CLFAGS
export RC_NONARCH_CFLAGS="$prefixMap" RC_NONARCH_CLFAGS="$prefixMap"
# ld64 writes each .o mtime into the N_OSO entries unless this is set,
# and -oso_prefix in the cmake flags drops the source root from their paths
export ZERO_AR_DATE=1

if [ -e src/Kernel/xnu/Makefile ]; then
  sed -i 's#/bin/pwd#pwd#g' src/Kernel/xnu/Makefile
fi
if [ -e src/Kernel/xnu/cmake/MakeInc.cmd.in ]; then
  sed -i "s#/usr/local/osxcross/bin/xcrun#/nix/store/v79myw3b0pnc2cmg7mvnpgg13qvcgivp-darwin-cross-toolchain-nix/bin/xcrun#g" \
    src/Kernel/xnu/cmake/MakeInc.cmd.in
  sed -i -E 's#(^|[[:space:]=])/(usr/)?bin/([A-Za-z_]+)#\1\3#g' \
    src/Kernel/xnu/cmake/MakeInc.cmd.in
fi
if [ -e tools/mig/mig.sh ]; then
  sed -i "s#/usr/local/osxcross/bin/xcrun#/nix/store/v79myw3b0pnc2cmg7mvnpgg13qvcgivp-darwin-cross-toolchain-nix/bin/xcrun#g" \
    tools/mig/mig.sh
fi

    mkdir -p .nix-stubs
    cat > .nix-stubs/sw_vers <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo 11.3
EOF
    chmod +x .nix-stubs/sw_vers
    export PATH="$PWD/.nix-stubs:$PATH"
    if [ -e src/Kernel/xnu/cmake/make_symbol_aliasing.sh.in ]; then
      sed -i '1s#.*#\#!'"$(command -v bash)"'#' src/Kernel/xnu/cmake/make_symbol_aliasing.sh.in
    fi
    patchShebangs src tools
    if [ -e tools/mig ]; then
      patchShebangs tools/mig
    fi
    if [ -e src/Kernel/xnu/SETUP/config/doconf ]; then
      sed -i '1c#!/nix/store/w6cnk49p978fanc23hvcgwg8n2bb67b7-tcsh-6.24.16/bin/tcsh -f' src/Kernel/xnu/SETUP/config/doconf
    fi

export NIX_NATIVE_LD_PATH="/nix/store/zh97dw620rygxqmi2m9cl72l3cinp3f2-puredarwin-native-ld-0.1/bin/ld"
export NIX_HOST_CC_PATH="/nix/store/g0b7s3chm06dn4653xll5j9ilp25gscg-clang-wrapper-21.1.8/bin/clang"
export NIX_MIGCOM_PATH="/nix/store/gxzbfc870kyb80wzkf0jgcp7lw2k0311-puredarwin-migcom-native-0.1/bin/migcom"
export NIX_UNIFDEF_PATH="/nix/store/88na65s5i18lqy9afdwai51xzrk2z1v7-puredarwin-unifdef-native-0.1/bin/unifdef"

cmake -S . -B build-nix -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/nix-toolchain.cmake \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
  -DOPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR=/nix/store/33n9vfhwvq35sa9qmyd0c7l61m539c1v-openssl-3.6.3-dev/include \
  -DOPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY=/nix/store/604a9ayx3kdxqlx72f5wb39gn401y38v-openssl-3.6.3/lib/libcrypto.so \
  -DOPENSSL_SSL_LIBRARY=/nix/store/604a9ayx3kdxqlx72f5wb39gn401y38v-openssl-3.6.3/lib/libssl.so \
  -DZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR=/nix/store/c0aknb3309z44jvz8yc1aifn9ga1kh6n-zlib-1.3.2-dev/include \
  -DZLIB_LIBRARY=/nix/store/6zpwyx6p9swad42f0vx6rl4z0dp2kj1g-puredarwin-oss-sdk-26.5/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/usr/lib/libz.tbd \
  -DZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE=/nix/store/6zpwyx6p9swad42f0vx6rl4z0dp2kj1g-puredarwin-oss-sdk-26.5/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/usr/lib/libz.tbd \
  -DLIBXML2_INCLUDE_DIR=/nix/store/gbmgv3xf3nklcb2jgibnakb1cybw9ikg-libxml2-2.15.3-dev/include/libxml2 \
  -DLIBXML2_LIBRARY=/nix/store/xphdk97kdkgyrwl42w8qv3a2gl3021hy-libxml2-2.15.3/lib/libxml2.so \
  -DPUREDARWIN_MACOSX_SDK="$DARWIN_SDK_ROOT" \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ARCH=arm64 \
  -DPUREDARWIN_COMPILER_RT_PREFIX=/nix/store/kyb8nz7xhpj984pwxwhfs0r6hgw8vy04-puredarwin-compiler-rt-21.1.8 \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ENABLE_PROJECTS=ON \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ENABLE_KERNEL=ON \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ENABLE_LIBRARIES=ON \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ENABLE_USERSPACE=OFF \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ENABLE_TOOLS=ON \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ENABLE_TCC=OFF \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ENABLE_IOGRAPHICS_FAMILY=OFF \
  -DPUREDARWIN_XNU_KERNEL_CONFIG=DEBUG \
  -DPUREDARWIN_TCC_SOURCE=/nix/store/8rvk0csx75g8n2lpnhzih7v3x62cda9i-source \
   \
   \
   \
  "-DCMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS=-Wl,-oso_prefix,$PWD/" \
  -DPUREDARWIN_ARM64_MACHINE_CONFIG=T8103
runHook postConfigure
env.installPhase:
runHook preInstall
mkdir -p $out
cp -R build-nix/src/Kernel/xnu/xnu/. $out/
runHook postInstall
env.name: puredarwin-kernel-arm64-t8103-firstboot-0.1
